title: Te Wairua Mataara i te taha o te awa
intro: I tukua he misioni ngaro ki tētahi wairua taitamariki, kia mātakitaki mai i tawhiti i te whanaketanga o te ao i runga i ngā wai. Kāore i kitea, kāore hoki i whakaarohia, ka whai wāhi nui tēnei tangata ki te whakarerekē i te huarahi o te hītori o tētahi iwi.
clues: I homai he mahi ki ahau e tōku whaea, he mahi e hiahia ana kia huna, kia mataara hoki.
I aru ōku kanohi i tētahi whāriki iti e tere ana i te ia, e taumaha ana tōku ngākau i te manukanuka.
I te kitenga o tētahi rōpū kāore i te tumanakohia, ka whakatata atu ahau, me te wehi nui.
I kite ahau i tō rātou hiahia nui ki tētahi kaitiaki, ā, i tukuna atu e ahau he otinga, engari kāore i whakakitea te pono.
Nā taku wawaotanga i te wā tika i whakahoki mai ai te wairua atawhai ki te hunga i tino matea.
I roto i ngā marae o te hunga whai mana, i kōrero ahau: 'Me ārahi koe e ahau ki tētahi whānau hei whāngai i a ia, hei tiaki hoki i a ia me te atawhai?'

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: Te maka o te tamaiti ki te awa
Te tahunga o te kuao kau
Te mate urutā o ngā mawhitiwhiti
trial.answer: Te maka o te tamaiti ki te awa

outcome.label: Hua
options: I tūtaki anō ia i te tamaiti ki tōna whaea
I whakaorangia e ia i a ia anō i ngā hōia a Parao
I whiua ia mō te tutei
outcome.answer: I tūtaki anō ia i te tamaiti ki tōna whaea

arabic: ۞ وَحَرَّمْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَرَاضِعَ مِن قَبْلُ فَقَالَتْ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَهْلِ بَيْتٍۢ يَكْفُلُونَهُۥ لَكُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُۥ نَـٰصِحُونَ
verse: And We had prevented from him [all] wet nurses before, so she said, "Shall I direct you to a household that will be responsible for him for you while they are to him [for his upbringing] sincere?" (28:12)
